## ecmcMO7062-0100_OPT.cmd

[Source: hardware/Beckhoff_MX/ecmcMO7062-0100_OPT.cmd](https://github.com/paulscherrerinstitute/ecmccfg/blob/master/hardware/Beckhoff_MX/ecmcMO7062-0100_OPT.cmd)

Documented configuration options:

- MODE CSV (default), CSP or CST; MO currently supports CSV only.
- TP, ENC2 0/1, default 1; suffix _1/_2 overrides a channel.
- INPUTS Must be 0 (default); MO7062 has no digital inputs.
- DIAG Shared voltage/temperature, default 1.
- EXT_DIAG Actual velocity/torque and CSP following error, default 0.
- TP_DC Touch-probe 1 timestamps, default 0; requires TP=1.
- AUTOTUNE Load tuning records, default 1.
